command:
set -eo pipefail
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH
export TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp LC_ALL=C
cd /tmp

echo "== minfiData ships the IDATs, the manifest and the annotation: nothing is staged =="
ls /opt/conda/lib/R/library/minfiData/extdata | head

cat > check.R <<'REOF'
suppressMessages({library(minfi); library(minfiData)})
pv <- function(p) as.character(packageVersion(p))
cat(sprintf("%-30s %s\n", "minfi_version", pv("minfi")))
cat(sprintf("%-30s %s\n", "minfiData_version", pv("minfiData")))
cat(sprintf("%-30s %s\n", "manifest_version", pv("IlluminaHumanMethylation450kmanifest")))
data(RGsetEx)
pd <- as.data.frame(pData(RGsetEx))
fail <- character(0)
ck <- function(lab, ok, detail) { cat(sprintf("%-30s %s\n", lab, detail)); if (!ok) fail <<- c(fail, lab) }
ob <- function(lab, detail) cat(sprintf("%-30s %s   [observation]\n", lab, detail))

ck("samples", nrow(pd) == 6, sprintf("%d  want exactly 6 (minfiData RGsetEx)", nrow(pd)))
ck("array_type", identical(unname(annotation(RGsetEx)["array"]), "IlluminaHumanMethylation450k"),
   sprintf("%s / %s  want IlluminaHumanMethylation450k", annotation(RGsetEx)["array"], annotation(RGsetEx)["annotation"]))
# three individuals, each contributing a normal AND a cancer sample -- the design that makes
# the identity check below a combinatorial truth rather than a clustering opinion
tb <- table(pd$person)
ck("three_persons_paired", length(tb) == 3 && all(tb == 2),
   sprintf("%s  want 3 persons x 2 samples", paste(sprintf("%s=%d", names(tb), tb), collapse=" ")))

gr <- mapToGenome(ratioConvert(preprocessRaw(RGsetEx)))
b  <- getBeta(preprocessRaw(RGsetEx))
# 485,512 is the 450k array's probe count after mapping -- exact, not a band
ck("probes", nrow(b) == 485512, sprintf("%d  want exactly 485512 (450k array)", nrow(b)))
# beta = M/(M+U+offset) with both intensities non-negative, so [0,1] is algebra
rng <- range(b, na.rm = TRUE)
ck("beta_in_range", rng[1] >= 0 && rng[2] <= 1,
   sprintf("[%.6f, %.6f] over %s values  want within [0,1]", rng[1], rng[2], format(length(b), big.mark=",")))

# TRUTH 1: sex predicted from X/Y intensity must equal the sex the package ships
ps <- getSex(gr)$predictedSex
ck("predicted_sex_matches", all(ps == pd$sex),
   sprintf("%s vs annotated %s  %d/%d agree", paste(ps, collapse=""), paste(pd$sex, collapse=""),
           sum(ps == pd$sex), nrow(pd)))

# TRUTH 2: the 450k array carries 65 SNP probes specifically for sample identity. Each
# sample's nearest neighbour by SNP beta must be its own donor's other sample -- a
# combinatorial claim (3 correct pairs out of 15 possible), not a similarity threshold.
sb <- getSnpBeta(RGsetEx)
ck("snp_probes", nrow(sb) == 65, sprintf("%d  want exactly 65 (450k identity probes)", nrow(sb)))
d <- as.matrix(dist(t(sb))); diag(d) <- Inf
nn <- colnames(d)[apply(d, 1, which.min)]
same <- pd$person[match(nn, rownames(pd))] == pd$person
ck("snp_identifies_donor", all(same),
   sprintf("%d/%d samples' nearest neighbour is the same person", sum(same), length(same)))
ob("snp_within_vs_between", sprintf("median within-donor %.4f vs between-donor %.4f",
   median(d[cbind(1:6, match(nn, colnames(d)))]), median(d[is.finite(d)])))
ob("detection_p_median", sprintf("%.3e", median(detectionP(RGsetEx), na.rm = TRUE)))

if (length(fail)) { cat("FAILED: ", paste(fail, collapse=", "), "\n"); quit(status = 1) }
REOF
# Rscript, not R CMD BATCH: output must reach stdout unbuffered so a killed run still
# leaves what it had (the catalog's dying-run rule).
Rscript check.R > smoke-check.txt 2>&1 || { cat smoke-check.txt; exit 1; }

echo "== export for the SeSAMe cross-check: minfi's betas, and the IDATs themselves =="
# sesame runs in its own image (one tool per image), which does not carry minfiData --
# so the IDATs have to travel. A directory cannot be a spawn output on the container
# path, hence one flat tar (practices/container-path.md).
cat > export.R <<'REOF'
suppressMessages({library(minfi); library(minfiData)})
data(RGsetEx)
b <- getBeta(preprocessRaw(RGsetEx))
colnames(b) <- rownames(as.data.frame(pData(RGsetEx)))
write.table(round(b, 6), gzfile("/tmp/minfi-betas.tsv.gz"), sep="\t", quote=FALSE)
cat("exported", nrow(b), "x", ncol(b), "betas\n")
REOF
Rscript export.R
tar -cf /tmp/idats.tar -C /opt/conda/lib/R/library/minfiData/extdata .
ls -l /tmp/minfi-betas.tsv.gz /tmp/idats.tar

cat smoke-check.txt
echo "SMOKE CHECK PASSED"
